title: adicea ciliaris
intro: Adicea ciliaris, commonly known as "Kakadu plum", is a small tree native to Australia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to boost the immune system and protect against UV radiation. The therapeutic actions of Adicea ciliaris include wound healing, antiviral and antibacterial activities, and potential treatments for certain types of cancer and neurological disorders. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, such as vitamin C, which is one of the highest concentrations found in any plant species.
